notes: IIQ S (format 6) decoder in src/shootflow/iiq.py, Python reference + C. Checked with tools/iiq_libraw_check.py against rawpy 0.28 / LibRaw 0.22.2 on six raw.pixls.us IIQ S files (IQ180 x2, iXU180, IQ3 100MP, iXM-100, iXM-RS150F): 546,893,560 sensels, 0 differing; plus three IIQ L files from two new bodies, 205,797,848 sensels, 0 differing. Real-file case: refinement above scale (negative shift, UB in LibRaw's C) in 880 samples over three files, all with zero bits; right/zero/wrap readings all give 0 differing sensels (tools/iiq_s_shift_check.py, eval/phaseone-iiq-s-shift-2026-11-18.jsonl). Fixed tools/iiq_develop_check.py's BT.709/sRGB flaw (gamma=(1,1)); IQ180 S and L develop gaps 0.0182 file matrix / 0.0035 LibRaw matrix; larger files OOM in the container. Format layout learned from LibRaw's LGPL decode_S_type for the layout only, implemented independently (credited in the docstring and eval), following the CR3/RW2 precedent. tests/test_iiq.py: 12 passed, 1 skipped; with SHOOTFLOW_IIQ_SAMPLES 1 passed. test_camera_profiles/card_formats/cr3/hasselblad: 54 passed.
